artworks.title: Au Jardin d'Acclimatation (In the Zoological Garden)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with roulette on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of birds in a park or wooded area. The scene includes various birds near a latticed fence. The landscape is filled with lush foliage and trees. The drawing shows detailed lines depicting the birds' feathers and the patterns of leaves and branches. The birds seem at ease in the natural setting.

artworks.title: Au Jardin d'Acclimatation (In the Zoological Garden)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: The image features two women shown standing from head to waist in a natural setting. The woman in the foreground is on the right, leaning her arms on a netted barrier. She has delicate facial features, intricate frilled hair, and wears a hat with floral decorations. She is dressed in textured, dark clothing. Behind her, the second woman is partially obscured by foliage, also wearing a flowing garment and a large decorative hat on her styled hair. Various exotic birds like peacocks and pheasants are depicted to the right of the women amidst trees and bushes. The background is filled with shrubs and leaves, creating a lush, ornate setting.

artworks.title: Au Jardin d'Acclimatation (In the Zoological Garden)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on Japan paper
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of two women in a garden-like setting, with only their upper bodies visible. The woman in the foreground leans against a netted fence, looking at birds on the ground. She has curly hair in an updo, covered by a flower-adorned hat, and wears a dark long-sleeve dress. The second woman stands behind and to the side, also looking ahead. She has hair under a hat and wears light robes. The background includes dense foliage.

artworks.title: Au Jardin d'Acclimatation (In the Zoological Garden)
artworks.medium: color etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: Two women are shown standing behind a slightly inclined fence, facing a group of colorful birds. The woman in the foreground has dark hair and a hat with a yellow decoration, wearing a dark dress with puffy sleeves and gloves. She has her chin resting on her hands. The second woman, behind her, wears a white hat with a veil and lighter-colored clothing. The background has lush foliage and larger trees on the right. Several vividly colored birds are in the foreground.

artworks.title: Oil Drums
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of barrels stacked on a wooden dock or platform. The color palette is monochromatic, ranging from light grays to dark blacks, indicating it is a black and white photograph. The barrels are placed towards the right side of the image, with shadows cast on the platform on the left. Water is visible in the upper portion of the image, with a lightly textured surface and reflections from the light source.

artworks.title: Wich-Ha-Ka-Sa, Ute
artworks.artist: John K. Rose, Benjamin S. Hopkins
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Clinton and Jean Wright and Chief Curator Discretionary Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a person's upper body facing slightly to the left, looking directly at the camera. The individual has high cheekbones, a prominent nose, and focused eyes. They have straight, long hair parted in the middle with a feather standing upright at the back. The person wears a decorated shirt with fur accents around the shoulders and a breastplate made of horizontal rows of cylindrical beads or bones. Large circular earrings and a choker-like necklace are also visible. The background is softly blurred, suggesting a studio setting with a neutral, textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Galerie Gmurzynska
artworks.description: The image is a close-up sketch of a person's face, showing the head and partial neck, focusing on the facial features. The pencil outlines display a broad forehead, thick eyebrows, wide eyes, a defined nose, and a firm mouth with full lips. The sketch suggests the shoulder-length hair is parted in the middle. The person is facing directly forward, providing a symmetrical view of the facial features. There are no visible clothing, jewelry, or objects in the sketch. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Galerie Gmurzynska
artworks.description: The image is a portrait drawing of a person's head, neck, and part of the shoulders. The person is facing forward with a calm expression, straight gaze, and closed lips. The hair is styled covering the ears with waves and a fringe across the forehead. The person is wearing an upper garment with a V-shaped neckline and a ruffled or pleated collar is visible under it. The background is plain. The drawing is in a soft pencil or charcoal medium, giving it a muted, monochromatic appearance.

artworks.title: Pharaoh’s Daughter Finding Moses
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: The image consists of a landscape scene with a border. The landscape includes cliffs, a small castle or fortress, trees, water, and figures by the water's edge. A sailboat sails nearby, and more ships are seen in the distance. The scene is depicted in fine, intricate line art with a monochromatic color palette of varying shades of gray. The border features birds, butterflies, and floral and faunal elements.

artworks.title: The Mocking Children Cursed by Elijah and Eaten by a She-Bear
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: The image is an intricately detailed engraving depicting a scenic pastoral view. The point of view is slightly elevated, showing a landscape with figures, including children, an adult, and animals gathered under a large tree. The scene opens up to a wide countryside with a village or town in the distance. The horizon is suggested by distant hills and structures, with an intricate decorative border containing flora and fauna. The monochrome palette emphasizes light, shadow, textures, and details.

artworks.title: Daniel in the Lion’s Den
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed print of a rocky landscape. In the forefront, a group of figures and lions can be seen within a cave. The figures are intricately depicted wearing detailed clothing. A tree is shown arching upwards to the right. In the background, a cityscape with buildings is visible, along with a textured sky. The composition is framed with ornamental decorations of birds and floral motifs. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of sepia or black ink on a neutral background, emphasizing the detailed linework.

artworks.title: The Baptism of Christ
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of a river scene in a mountainous landscape. The horizon features a cityscape with spires and fortified structures. In the middle, a bridge connects the city with rocky hillsides. Mythological or religious figures are depicted near a riverbank with trees. The water includes figures and rocks. The composition is monochromatic in shades of gray and black, emphasizing textures. A decorative border surrounds the central panel with floral elements, animals, and mythological creatures.

artworks.title: Christ and the Disciples in the Field
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated view over a pastoral setting. In the distance, there are buildings with pitched roofs. A border with floral and animal motifs surrounds the scene. Several figures are depicted in the fields, and in the distance, others are harvesting crops. The image is detailed with fine lines, rendered in monochrome shades.

artworks.title: The Sending Out of the Apostles
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a pastoral scene with a village view in the background. The scene is framed by flowers and animals like a lobster, butterfly, and rodent. The viewpoint is elevated, showing the landscape and the village. The horizon is high in the composition, showcasing houses and a church with a steeple. Figures are seen conversing and walking on paths near a winding dirt road. The etching features precise brushstrokes, fine lines, and crosshatching. The color palette is grayscale.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert E. Jackson
artworks.description: The image depicts two men in a studio setting. The man on the left is seated in a wagon, wearing a dark suit, bowler hat, and has a mustache. The man on the right, standing and holding the wagon's handle, also wears a dark suit and hat and has a mustache. Both men have short hair and wear formal Victorian-era attire. The background features painted foliage and architectural details, giving the impression of an outdoor environment. The lower edge of the image includes the photographer's information: "Macy & Doughty, Photographers, Norfolk, Neb."

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert E. Jackson
artworks.description: In the image, two men are posing side by side from head to toe. The man on the left has short, neatly styled hair, a mustache, and is wearing a three-piece suit. He is standing with his left hand resting on a table covered with a patterned cloth. The man on the right is wearing a traditional ensemble with a decorative vest, a wide sash around his waist, and patterned baggy trousers. He also has a mustache and is wearing a fez with a tassel. The background features an ornate wallpaper with a sculpture of a child on the table between them.

artworks.title: Yonan Y. Auraham
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert E. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows two men in traditional attire. The man on the left is kneeling, with his full body visible in the image, while the man on the right is standing, also showing his full body. The kneeling man has a prominent mustache and is wearing a headpiece that appears to be a turban. His clothing consists of an embroidered jacket, layered over a shirt, and he holds a long firearm upright in his hands. Around his waist is a sash that holds a large knife or sword. The standing man also has a mustache and wears a fez. He is dressed in a dark coat over a striped shirt, with a visible belt of ammunition. He too holds a firearm and has a larger, sheathed weapon resting at his side. The background is a textured, plain wall with decorative patterns engraved into it. There is a visible signature or studio label at the bottom of the card, reading "Hendricks & Co," along with an address in Allegheny, PA.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert E. Jackson
artworks.description: The image features two men standing facing each other. Both individuals are shown in full body shots, standing upright with hands at their sides. They have short-cropped hair and wear matching outfits - white button-up shirts, light-colored vests, dark trousers, and dark bowler hats. The background appears to be a studio with a light-toned backdrop, a rug beneath their feet, and a curtain partially visible on the left. The frame includes text crediting the photographer as J.R. Stewart from Murphysboro, Illinois.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert E. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a young man standing indoors. His reflection is seen to the side. He is standing upright, facing his reflection. The man has short, neat hair and a clean-shaven face. He is dressed in formal attire from the same era as the photo. He holds a hat in one hand, positioned low by his side. The background includes ornate wall decorations and a patterned rug.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert E. Jackson
artworks.description: The image features two men sitting at a small table. The man on the left is glancing down at an open book or document on the table, while the man on the right holds a bowler hat in his hands. The table also holds another bowler hat, a decorative box, and some papers. The background shows patterned drapery with floral designs and part of an upholstered armchair. The ground is covered with a fur or plush rug. The photograph is sepia-toned.

artworks.title: The Docks (Honesdale)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ron Perisho
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated perspective of an industrial scene featuring railway tracks, barges, buildings, and a hillside with sparse trees. The railway tracks run alongside cargo cars filled with goods, leading to the waterway where barges are docked. There is a church steeple among the buildings on the hillside. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving the scene an aged appearance, emphasizing its historical industrial atmosphere. In the distance, more buildings can be seen spreading across the hills against a light sky.

artworks.title: Hampton Court on Thames
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Patrick Montgomery
artworks.description: The image depicts a riverside scene with a historic building surrounded by trees. A large river is in the foreground, reflecting the sky and trees. People are gathered near a boat on the riverbank, and in the background, there is a castle-like building surrounded by dense trees. The scene is captured in a monochrome print, emphasizing textures and shadows with detailed branches and foliage. The color palette is grayscale, contrasting the light sky with the darker elements like the trees and water.

artworks.title: Ruines des environs de Rhodes
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Rena M. Hoisington in honor of Mary Lee Corlett

artworks.title: Reflection
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman wearing a large coat and skirt. She is seated with her body angled to the side, head turned slightly towards the viewer. The woman has delicate facial features, with her hair covered by a fluffy hat. Her hands are resting in her lap as she sits on a wide chair. She is not wearing any visible jewelry or holding any objects. The background features simple vertical lines resembling a plain interior wall, creating a minimalist setting.
